# Bonsai

> > Bonsai is an all-in-one business management platform trusted by 500,000+ small businesses to streamline client relationships, project delivery, and financial operations.

Bonsai provides an integrated suite of tools for small business owners, freelancers, and agencies to manage every aspect of their operations—from client acquisition and project management to invoicing and financial reporting. The platform combines CRM, project management, time tracking, invoicing, and business intelligence into a single, unified workspace.

## Key Topics

- Client Management
- Project Management
- CRM
- Sales Pipeline
- Time Tracking
- Invoicing
- Payment Processing
- Resource Management
- Financial Management
- Task Management
- Proposal Builder
- Contract Management
- Client Portal
- Business Analytics
- White-Label Solutions

## Core Business Platform

- [Bonsai - Business management software](https://www.hellobonsai.com): Bonsai: business management platform for 500,000+ small businesses

## Client & Relationship Management

- [CRM for Small Business & Client Portal - Bonsai](https://www.hellobonsai.com/crm): Bonsai CRM with client portal for project and client management
- [Client Portal - Bonsai](https://www.hellobonsai.com/client-portal): Bonsai client portal: centralize communications and project tasks
- [Online Form Builder - Bonsai](https://www.hellobonsai.com/forms): Bonsai form builder: client intake, questionnaires, lead capture

## Sales & Pipeline Management

- [Manage your Sales Pipeline with Ease | Bonsai](https://www.hellobonsai.com/pipeline): Bonsai Deals Pipeline: track leads, proposals, and deals
- [Online Proposal Builder - Bonsai](https://www.hellobonsai.com/proposals): Bonsai proposal builder: create, send, track business proposals
- [Create Professional Project Estimates | Bonsai](https://www.hellobonsai.com/estimates): Bonsai Estimate Builder: forecast project scope, cost, timelines
